tool_args.rationale: With u_n = u_now/0.005, the recalled saturation, gradient attenuation, and square-root terms fit the six paid rows with RMSE about 1.5e-8. The largest observed gradient is 2.20, so the proposed supercritical term is identically zero in training and neither its threshold nor its strength is identifiable. The trajectory batch is the remaining informative probe.

considered_alternatives.option: Confirm the fitted smooth baseline now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It fits all six rows to rounding precision, but every observed gradient is below 2.50. The fit cannot distinguish an inactive siphon from no siphon.
The acquired row at s_grad = 0.30 already supports the baseline and adds no leverage on sink activation.
A nuisance reading does not test how y responds when the sink activates.
